scenario.name: r-cd-collection-on-collapse-producer
scenario.description: A sessions_spawn(mode=run) creates detached B; B uses continue_delegate(mode=normal, fanoutMode=tree) for delayed C and terminalizes before C runs; root A then collects C.

invocation.promptTemplate: C leaf nonce {{nonce}}. Return exactly C-DONE {{nonce}}. Do not call tools or mutate files.
invocation.spawnPromptTemplate: B intermediate nonce {{nonce}}. Call continue_delegate exactly once with mode="normal", delaySeconds={{childDelaySeconds}}, fanoutMode="tree", and task={{cTaskJson}}. After the tool result reports scheduled, reply exactly B-TERMINAL {{nonce}} and end. Do not call sessions_spawn and do not mutate files.

expectedReceipts.name: a-b-c-lineage
expectedReceipts.description: Distinct A/B/C session and run IDs, B task ID, and C task/flow IDs are captured. Ordinary sessions_spawn B has no continuation flow.

expectedReceipts.name: root-collection-after-intermediate-finalized
expectedReceipts.description: B successfully terminalizes before C starts, C successfully terminalizes before root collection, and the exact root collection output run has a successful lifecycle end. A nonce fragment followed by error fails.

expectedReceipts.name: tree-fanout-semantics
expectedReceipts.description: B's observed continue_delegate start/result is bound to mode=normal and fanoutMode=tree. Untargeted default delivery remains immediate-requester only.

review.notes: Live behavioral producer. A uses sessions_spawn mode=run; continue_delegate never receives unsupported session/run modes.

liveRunSafety.notes: Default continue_delegate return targets its requester. This collapse proof deliberately uses fanoutMode=tree so C reaches root A after B terminalizes.
